extracted_morphology.habit: Hairy erect wetland herb to 1.5 m
extracted_morphology.leaves: Alternate; lanceolate to broadly lanceolate; petioles 2–35 mm
extracted_morphology.flowers: Usually five-merous, rarely four sepals/petals; petals 5–11 mm, usually ten stamens
extracted_morphology.fruit: Capsules 15–50 mm; pedicels 2–20 mm; seeds 1–1.2 mm, each with horseshoe-shaped endocarp fragment
extracted_morphology.diagnosis: Distinguished from creeping/floating L. peploides by erect branches, short pedicels and individually detached seeds with endocarp fragments
